findings.title: Health First expands flooding-related outpatient suspension into November 3; reschedules appointments and cancels elective surgeries
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The following Health First locations and services are closed and will reopen no earlier than 10 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3.
findings.service_line: Medical Group outpatient/primary care; laboratory; imaging; outpatient, cardiac and pulmonary rehabilitation; pharmacy; elective surgery
findings.access_consequences: Material follow-up to November 2 morning closure: all Health First Medical Group sites, outpatient laboratory/imaging sites, rehabilitation programs and Gateway Family Pharmacy remain closed until no earlier than 10 a.m. November 3; Medical Group appointments are being rescheduled. Palm Bay Hospital elective surgeries canceled all day November 3; Babcock Surgery Center closed all day. Elective surgeries at Holmes Regional, Cape Canaveral, and Viera hospitals cannot resume before 10 a.m. November 3. Hospitals and emergency departments remain operational. No actual reopening is claimed.
findings.affected_population: Health First outpatient patients, patients with scheduled laboratory, rehabilitation, pharmacy and elective surgery services in Brevard County; exact number unknown.
findings.qualification_note: Newly surfaced material change in projected duration and documented scope, not a duplicate of the initial Monday morning clinic closure. Article dated November 2 but exact publication time not supplied, so announcement timing within this hourly window is not independently confirmed. Provider's hf.org/alert unavailable through browsing; production deduplication unverified.
